findings.title: R10 THT procedure allows selective soldering and names no bottom-side keep-offs, though U5's open port and every port ESD clamp sit 1.76-2.17 mm from DB125 holes

evidence.file: docs/ORDERING.md section 8.2 ('Hand/selective solder all eight DB125 bodies, not wave'); board m3_design/assembly_review/m3.kicad_pcb
evidence.gate: check_r10 M-6 requires only >= 1.5 mm (all pass)
evidence.contrast: R9's ORDERING section 4 (J3 legs) names iron keep-offs (C83 1.54 mm, R8 1.94 mm); the R10 section 8.2 DB125 bullet names none and 'protect U5's open pressure ports' appears only in the no-washing bullet
evidence.maker: TE MS5611-01BA03 datasheet, 'Mounting and assembly considerations', Cleaning (p16-17 of the cached PDF): protect the sensor opening from particles during assembly; no cleaning. Max soldering 250 C / 40 s (p3). https://www.te.com/commerce/DocumentDelivery/DDEController?Action=showdoc&DocId=Data+Sheet%7FMS5611-01BA03%7FB3%7Fpdf%7FEnglish%7FENG_DS_MS5611-01BA03_B3.pdf
evidence.selective_keepout: Inference from industry guidance (no JLC figure found): mini-wave nozzle keep-outs to bottom SMD are typically 3-6 mm (forum.kicad.info/t/selective-soldering-kicad-rule/34977; eevblog mixed SMD/PTH thread: assembler asks 4 mm)

findings.impact: If JLC chooses selective soldering (permitted by the remark), the 1.76-2.17 mm spacing is inside typical nozzle keep-outs: the TSLP-2-20 clamps (D400/D401/D410/D411/D420/D421/D440/D441) can reflow, shift or bridge, and solder/flux spatter can enter U5's open pressure port 6 mm from J121.1 on the same face, with no wash permitted to remove it. Bounded: hand soldering at this spacing is normal practice and first-article inspection would catch shifted parts; U5 contamination may not be visible.
findings.concrete_fix: Docs only: in ORDERING 8.2 change the remark to 'Hand-solder the eight DB125 bodies (no selective or wave)' unless JLC confirms its nozzle keep-out is < 1.7 mm; add a keep-off list (U5 and R13 at J121; D440/D441/R90/TP82 at J440; D410/D411 at J410; D420/D421/C421 at J420; D400/D401/C91 at J9; R150-R153 at J122) and require U5's port to be masked (e.g. a Kapton dot, removed afterwards) during J121's soldering; add 'inspect the TSLP clamps for shift/bridges after THT' to first-article inspection.
